description: CONTINUE AFTER arithmetic-expression SECONDS (ISO §2023:14.9.9) — a COBOL-2023 addition: a timed pause. Plain CONTINUE is 1985-continuous; only the AFTER … SECONDS phrase is gated. A negative interval is forced to 0 (GR1a) and sets the nonfatal EC-CONTINUE-LESS-THAN-ZERO under CHECKING ON (GR1b).
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CONTA.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CONTINUE AFTER 0 SECONDS.
    STOP RUN.
